ev.q: is a 2016 third-person shooter video game developed by PopCap Games
in which 12 players play as plants, and 12 play as zombies
There are also plant pots or places where the player can build either plant turrets or Zombie bots
collect collectibles scattered in the world
Critics also enjoyed the goofy nature of the game compared to other shooters
Even though the game may be considered to look childish
